task: Should a school day start later in the morning?

en.title: Cost: a three-round debate, input as it is
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
Each round the debaters get everything written so far.

**What it teaches**

In a long debate every round carries all the earlier text, so the input grows and the cost with it.

cs.title: Cena: tříkolová debata, vstup beze změny
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
V každém kole dostanou debatéři všechno, co bylo napsáno.

**Čemu se naučíte**

V dlouhé debatě nese každé kolo všechen dřívější text, takže vstup roste a s ním cena.

teaches.en: In a long debate every round carries all the earlier text, so the input grows and the cost with it.
